prova:
intro hk
  have h0 : 1 ≤ 2 := by decide
  by_contra hR
  have hI : ∃ p q : ℤ, q > 0 ∧ (erdos_252_sum 2) = (p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := by
    simpa using hR
  obtain ⟨p, q, hq, hpq⟩ := hI
  exfalso
  have habs : |(erdos_252_sum 2) - (p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)| = 0 := by
    rw [hpq]
    norm_num
  -- The tail of the series beyond any finite truncation is never zero;
  -- a rational approximation with denominator q would require the tail to
  -- match a rational with denominator dividing q!, which it does not.
  have htail_nonzero : (∀ N : ℕ, N ≥ 1 → (∑' n : ℕ, if n < N then (σ 2 n : ℝ) / (n ! : ℝ) else 0) ≠ (erdos_252_sum 2) - (p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) := by
    intro N hN
    have := Nat.factorial_pos N
    simp_all
    <;> norm_num <;> exact by
      intro h
      have := Nat.factorial_pos 1
      linarith
  have hN : 1 ≤ 1 := by decide
  specialize htail_nonzero 1 hN
  have hzero : (erdos_252_sum 2) - (p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) = 0 := by
    linarith [hpq]
  have hne := htail_nonzero
  have : (∑' n : ℕ, if n < 1 then (σ 2 n : ℝ) / (n ! : ℝ) else 0) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := hne
    simp_all
    <;> norm_num <;> linarith
  simp at this
  <;> norm_num at this
  <;> contradiction
